name: GOV optional: token mint (Transfer from 0x0)
description: Mint of one token: Transfer with from == 0x0. The ERC20 Token Transfer alert cannot watch 0x0, so this stays an Event alert with a parameter condition. The token must be a contract of the project with a verified ABI on Tenderly (the parameter must carry the ABI name, from for OpenZeppelin tokens). Replace the placeholders with the token and its network. Add a value >= condition to ignore small mints.
